# US-007: API Documentation & SignalR Hub Infrastructure

## Story

**As a** developer,
**I want** Swagger/OpenAPI documentation auto-generated and a SignalR hub configured for real-time communication,
**So that** API consumers have interactive documentation and the platform supports real-time features.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Epic** | EP-TECH |
| **Priority** | Medium |
| **Story Points** | 2 |
| **MoSCoW** | Must Have |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Swagger UI accessible at `/swagger` in Development environment
- [ ] OpenAPI spec includes all controller endpoints with request/response schemas
- [ ] JWT Bearer authentication configured in Swagger UI (Authorize button)
- [ ] SignalR hub configured at `/hubs/notifications`
- [ ] Hub supports: `SlotAvailabilityChanged`, `QueueStatusUpdated` events
- [ ] SignalR authentication validates JWT tokens
- [ ] WebSocket transport with long-polling fallback configured
- [ ] CORS configured for SignalR (frontend origin only)

## Technical Notes

- Swagger disabled in Production via environment check
- SignalR uses `Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR`
- Hub authorization: authenticated users only
- Group-based messaging for per-provider slot updates

## Traceability

| Requirement | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| TR-020 | Swagger/OpenAPI |
| TR-030 | SignalR real-time updates |
| NFR-023 | API documentation 100% coverage |
